LESSON: USES OF DOMESTIC ANIMALS

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: AGRICULTURE
Strand: Food Production Processes
Topic 2.2: Uses of Domestic Animals

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Uses of Domestic Animals. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Uses of Domestic Animals
2. Practise Uses of Domestic Animals at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Uses of Domestic Animals

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Uses of Domestic Animals
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Uses of Domestic Animals. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Uses of Domestic Animals at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Uses of Domestic Animals at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Uses of Domestic Animals
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Uses of Domestic Animals. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Uses of Domestic Animals using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Uses of Domestic Animals in the examples.
2. Explain Uses of Domestic Animals to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Uses of Domestic Animals.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Uses of Domestic Animals using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Uses of Domestic Animals important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Uses of Domestic Animals
2. Practise Uses of Domestic Animals at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Uses of Domestic Animals

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
